summary: Bottom navigation bar for 3–5 top-level destinations on mobile.
whenToUse: Apps and portals used primarily on smartphones.
whenNotToUse: More than 5 destinations: use a navigation Drawer.
Desktop: use Sidebar or NavigationMenu (hideFrom hides the bar).

props.name: items
props.description: { id, label, icon, href?, linkProps?, badge?, badgeLabel? }. With href they render as links.

props.name: position
props.description: Fixed to the bottom (with safe area) or in the normal flow.

props.name: hideFrom
props.description: Breakpoint from which the bar is hidden.

keyboard.action: Each destination is a native link or button.

accessibility: nav landmark; the active destination has aria-current="page".
Labels are always visible (not icons only).
badgeLabel provides the accessible text for the badge (e.g. “3 unread”).
responsive: Targets of at least 48 px; respects env(safe-area-inset-bottom).
With position fixed, reserve space at the bottom of the content (AppShell handles this).
commonMistakes: Using the bar for actions (e.g. “Salva”) instead of destinations.

examples.name: UncontrolledLinks
examples.title: Five destinations as links, uncontrolled
examples.description: defaultValue sets the initial item; onChange records the latest destinations. Badges have an accessible badgeLabel.

examples.name: LongLabels
examples.title: Three destinations with long labels
examples.description: Controlled value that can also be changed from external buttons; long labels wrap in a narrow space.
